verdict.rationale: The evidence only gets near the story. Custom Integrations let you create and map custom resources from unsupported tools, and Secureframe then normalizes, maps and tests them. The MCP server also exposes controls, tests and frameworks as manageable objects. No evidence explicitly shows users authoring their own custom frameworks, custom controls, custom tests or evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones. Missing for 10: explicit custom framework creation, custom control authoring, user-defined test logic, configurable evidence requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.
